第十章 戒指与画布
到了最后，利维坦猩猩已是完全放弃了八级魔兽的尊严，惨叫声中充满了求饶的意味，在地上又是打躬又是作揖，只差没跪下去给林立磕上几个响头了。
“这死猩猩，居然还知道打不过就投降？”林立看得是眼界大开，难怪安度因说，它们只是一群喜欢捣乱的小痞子，打得过就在人脸上画圈圈，打不过就趴地上求饶，这真是一头八级魔兽吗？
对这么个惫赖家伙，林立还真不好把它怎么样。
就这么把它放了，林立自然是不甘心的，可顺手杀掉，却又好想有点没意思，想来想去竟弄得林立有些头大，恼火之下怒气自然又撒到了利维坦猩猩头上，这一次也不用什么风刃了，只见这家伙随手扯了一根藤条就开抽，一边抽还一边骂：“让你绑票勒索！让你拿椰子砸老子！让你朝着老子怪笑……对了，刚才老子骂倒哪了？算了，重新骂过……让你绑架勒索……”
这一通劈头盖脑的乱揍，直揍得那可怜的利维坦猩猩是四季花儿开，堂堂八级魔兽在一根藤条面前，竟是连躲都不敢躲，一直揍到林立都觉得有些手软了，才总算是悻悻的停下手来，再看看那可怜的利维坦猩猩，早已经是不堪蹂躏，将个脑袋彻底埋进了土里。
而一旁的麦格雷尼和伊娜则看得是目瞪口呆，这一路走来，他们对林立的实力也算是有些了解，知道这是一个强大的魔法师，可他们却从来没想过，林立的实力竟会强到这种程度，那无限风刃的场景，让他们觉得自己就好象是在做梦一样。
麦格雷尼也算是资深冒险者了，见过的魔法师不少，可他却从来没见过，有哪个魔法师能象林立一样变态，看看先前那一片风刃，简直比利维坦猩猩的椰子还要密集几分。
等到之后林立将利维坦猩猩抽得满地打滚的时候，麦格雷尼父女已经彻底麻木了，在他们看来，这个少年魔法师简直就是一个怪物……
“看你以后还敢不敢乱嚣张……”林立过足了手瘾，这才神清气爽的丢掉手中藤条，有朝四周看了一眼,准备招呼麦格雷尼父女闪人.
可这番举动落入利维坦猩猩眼中，却是以为他要换根藤条再来，刚挨了一顿胖揍的它，顿时吓得魂飞魄散，也顾不得再继续装死了，赶紧从地上蹦了起来，一边“呜呜呜呜”的求情，一边指着远处的一棵巨树。
“干嘛？”
“呜呜呜呜呜！”
“呜个毛……”林立不耐烦的踹了利维坦猩猩一脚，目光顺着它所指点的方向望去：“你该不会是在那里藏了个利维坦猩猩美女，准备献给我吧？”
“呜呜呜……”
“除呜呜呜呜，你还会不会点别的？”
“呜呜呜！”
“……”
实在受不了这个只会“呜呜”乱叫的家伙，林立干脆由它领着到巨树下去看上一眼。
巨下下堆满了厚厚的一层落叶，只是比起密林中那些已经腐败的落叶来，这里的落叶显得异常干爽，其中一些甚至还带着一抹绿色，很明显是刚被人从树上扯下来的。

不等林立吩咐，利维坦猩猩已是三下两下拨开树下的落叶，露出一个又深又大的树洞来。
“我靠！”林立往那树洞里看了一眼，顿时觉得，这死猩猩太有才了，生生把个树洞弄成了百宝箱，看看里面都藏了些什么，锈迹斑斑的武器盔甲，闪闪发亮的玻璃珠子，一堆五颜六色的颜料，甚至还有一块被涂得乱七八糟的画布……
闹了半天，这家伙献宝似的把自己领来，就是为了让自己看这么一堆破东西？林立真是又好气又好笑。
正要转身离去，却忽然感觉到，那一堆乱七八糟的东西当中，竟透出一股微弱的魔法波动。这种感觉对林立来说，实在是太熟悉了，不管是手上的无尽风暴之戒，还是身上的怒焰法袍，都总是在不经意间透出这种淡淡的魔法波动。
“还真藏着好东西？”林立不由愣了一下，能够散发出微弱魔法波动的，绝不会是一般的东西，就连老法师送给他的那根法杖，也够不上这样的资格。
惊喜之余，林立也没空去处理利维坦猩猩了，赶忙弯下腰去，在树洞中一番挑选。
他的感觉果然没错，在将那块五颜六色的画布扯开之后，林立很快就在一堆玻璃珠中，找到了一枚戒指。
那戒指的色泽看上去有些灰暗，也不知道用的是什么材料，但工艺却是细腻而又精致，一道道精细的花纹盘绕，如同众星拱月一般托起一颗黑色的钻石。而那淡淡的魔法波动，就是从这颗钻石上透出的。
林立第一眼看见戒指，就被上面的钻石吸引住了。
那是一种近乎本能般的直觉，林立知道，这绝对是一件强大的魔法装备，至少不会比自己身上的怒焰之袍差。
“好吧好吧……既然你这么有诚意，那我就不客气了……”林立逗小孩似的拍了拍利维坦猩猩的脑袋，大概是因为弄了个戒指心情不错的缘故，此时再看利维坦猩猩，倒也不象先前那般面目可憎了。
“嘎嘎嘎！”利维坦猩猩只是傻笑，看上去倒是挺高兴的，也不知道是高兴林立收下了戒指，还是高兴自己终于可以送走这个瘟神。
意外的弄到了一件魔法装备，林立一时间心情大好，也没兴趣再为难利维坦猩猩，只是在它屁股上踹了一脚：“滚吧！”
挨了一脚，利维坦猩猩却是如蒙大赦，吭哧吭哧的就钻入了树林深处。
拿了戒指正准备闪人，却忽然看见那张被涂得五颜六色的画布。
这时候林立才注意到，那涂得乱七八糟的颜料之下，似乎还有些什么东西。
林立有些奇怪，顺手把画布捡了起来。
仔细辨认之下，才发现那画布上，似乎有些弯弯曲曲的的符号。
“高等精灵文！”林立当时就吓了一跳，安度因那间小木屋里，藏了不少的魔法书，其中有一部分正是用高等精灵文书写，只是因为林立刚刚接触魔法，基础还打得不太牢靠，安度因从来不让他碰这些东西罢了。
文字内容林立看不明白，但他至少知道，只要跟高等精灵扯上关系的，就绝不会是一般的东西。

所以他一点也没有犹豫，顺手就把那张脏兮兮的画布揣进了怀里。
三人回到山洞的时候，克伦威尔正盯着篝火发呆。
“伊娜！”见麦格雷尼父女安然无恙，热心魔法师大吃一惊，抓走伊娜那怪物实在太强大了，速度就象闪电一样，瞬间见自己打倒在地，同时抢走了伊娜，他怎么也想不到，三人竟能安然无恙的救回伊娜。
想到那怪物的可怕，顿时就记起了自己先前的表现，记起了自己丢下伊娜，一个人逃回来的狼狈。
一时间克伦威尔只觉得脸上有些发烫，整个人就这么僵在那里，站也不是坐也不是，最后还是林立帮他解了危。
“时候不早了，大家早点休息吧。”
content_en:
Chapter 10 The Ring and the Canvas
By the end, the Leviathan orangutan had completely given up on its dignity as an eighth-level monster. Its screams were full of begging for mercy. It bowed and saluted on the ground, only barely kneeling down to kowtow to Lin Li a few times.
"This damn orangutan actually knows how to surrender if it can't be beaten?" Lin Li's eyesight was opened. No wonder Anduin said that they are just a group of little gangsters who like to make trouble. If they can beat people, they will draw circles on people's faces. If they can't beat them, they will lie on the ground and beg for mercy. Is this really an eighth-level monster?
Lin Li really couldn't do anything to such a tired guy.
Lin Li was naturally unwilling to let it go just like that, but it was a bit boring to kill it easily. Thinking about it made Lin Li feel a little dizzy. When he was annoyed, his anger naturally spread on the head of the Leviathan gorilla. This time, there was no need for a wind blade. Seeing this guy casually pulling out a cane, he started whipping him, and while he was whipping him, he cursed: "I asked you to kidnap me for blackmail! I asked you to hit me with a coconut! I made you smile weirdly at me... By the way, what did I scold you just now? Forget it, I scolded you again... I asked you to kidnap and extort you..."
This round of beatings hit the poor Leviathan gorilla so hard that the majestic eighth-level monster didn't even dare to hide in front of a vine. The beating continued until Lin Li felt a little weak, and then he finally stopped angrily. Looking at the poor Leviathan gorilla, he could no longer bear the ravage, and his head was completely buried in the soil.
McGraney and Ina on the side were stunned. Along the way, they had some understanding of Lin Li's strength and knew that he was a powerful magician. However, they never thought that Lin Li's strength could be so strong. The scene of the infinite wind blade made them feel as if they were in a dream.
McGraney is also a veteran adventurer. He has seen many magicians, but he has never seen any magician who can be as perverted as Lin Li. Look at the wind blades from before, they are almost denser than the coconuts of Leviathan orangutans.
By the time Lin Li whipped the Leviathan gorilla until it was rolling all over the floor, the McGraneys were completely numb. In their eyes, this young magician was simply a monster...
"Let's see if you dare to be arrogant in the future..." Lin Li was satisfied with his hand addiction, and then he threw away the cane in his hand in a refreshing mood, and glanced around, preparing to call out the McGraneys and his daughter.
However, in the eyes of the Leviathan orangutan, what he did was because he thought he was going to use a cane again. Having just received a heavy beating, it was so frightened that it no longer wanted to pretend to be dead. It quickly jumped up from the ground, begging for mercy while pointing to a giant tree in the distance.
"What for?"
"Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu!"
"Ugh..." Lin Li kicked the Leviathan orangutan impatiently and looked in the direction pointed by it: "You must be hiding a beautiful Leviathan orangutan there, ready to present it to me, right?"
"Woooooooo..."
"Apart from woo woo woo, would you order anything else?"
"Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu"
"..."
Really couldn't stand this guy who only whined randomly, so Lin Li simply let him lead him to the giant tree to take a look.
There was a thick layer of fallen leaves piled under the giant tree, but compared to the rotten fallen leaves in the dense forest, the fallen leaves here seemed unusually dry. Some of them even had a touch of green, and it was obvious that they had just been torn from the trees.
Without waiting for Lin Li's instructions, the Leviathan orangutan had already pushed aside the fallen leaves under the tree, revealing a deep and large tree hole.
"Holy shit!" Lin Li glanced at the tree hole and suddenly felt that this dead orangutan was so talented. He had turned the tree hole into a treasure chest. Look at what was hidden inside, including rusty weapons and armor, and shiny glass.Glass beads, a bunch of colorful paints, and even a messy canvas...
After quarreling for a long time, this guy brought me here like a treasure, just to show him such a pile of junk? Lin Li was really angry and funny.
Just as he was about to turn around and leave, he suddenly felt a faint magic wave coming from among the messy things. This feeling was all too familiar to Lin Li. Whether it was the Ring of Endless Storm in his hand or the Raging Flame Robe on his body, this faint magical fluctuation was always revealed inadvertently.
"Is there really something good hidden there?" Lin Li couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Something that could emit weak magic waves was definitely not an ordinary thing. Even the staff given to him by the old mage was not qualified to do so.
Surprised, Lin Li had no time to deal with the Leviathan gorilla, so he hurriedly bent down and selected among the tree holes.
His feeling was indeed correct. After tearing apart the colorful canvas, Lin Li quickly found a ring among a pile of glass beads.
The color of the ring looks a bit gray, and I don't know what material it is made of, but the craftsmanship is delicate and exquisite, with fine patterns coiled around it, holding up a black diamond like stars over the moon. And that faint magic wave comes from this diamond.
When Lin Li first saw the ring, he was attracted by the diamonds on it.
It was an almost instinctive intuition. Lin Li knew that this was definitely a powerful piece of magical equipment, at least no worse than the Robe of Raging Flames he wore.
"Okay, okay... Since you are so sincere, I won't be polite..." Lin Li patted the Leviathan gorilla on the head like a kid, probably because he felt good about getting a ring. Looking at the Leviathan gorilla now, he didn't look as hateful as before.
"Quack!" The Leviathan gorilla just giggled and looked quite happy. He didn't know whether he was happy that Lin Li accepted the ring, or whether he was happy that he could finally send this plague god away.
Lin Li accidentally got a piece of magic equipment. Lin Li was in a good mood for a while. He was not interested in embarrassing the Leviathan orangutan anymore. He just kicked it on the butt and said, "Get out of here!"
After receiving a kick, the Leviathan orangutan felt as if it had been granted amnesty, and squeaked into the depths of the forest.
He took the ring and was about to escape when he suddenly saw the colorful canvas.
Only then did Lin Li notice that there seemed to be something underneath the messy paint.
Lin Li felt a little strange and picked up the canvas.
After careful examination, I discovered that there seemed to be some winding symbols on the canvas.
"High Elven script!" Lin Li was startled at that time. There were a lot of magic books hidden in Anduin's cabin, some of which were written in High Elven script. It was just because Lin Li had just come into contact with magic and his foundation was not very solid. Anduin never let him touch these things.
Lin Li couldn't understand the content of the text, but at least he knew that anything related to high elves would never be ordinary.
So he didn't hesitate at all and put the dirty canvas into his arms.
When the three returned to the cave, Cromwell was staring at the bonfire in a daze.
"Ina!" Seeing that McGraney and his daughter were safe and sound, the zealous magician was shocked. The monster that captured Ina was too powerful. It was as fast as lightning. In an instant, he was knocked to the ground and took away Ina at the same time. He never expected that the three of them could actually rescue Ina safely.
Thinking of the horror of the monster, he immediately remembered his previous performance and how embarrassed he was when he left Ina behind and escaped alone.
For a moment, Cromwell only felt a little hot on his face, and his whole body was frozen there, neither standing nor sitting.In the end, Lin Li helped him out of danger.
"It's getting late, let's go to bed early."
